Ineffa is a playable Electro character in Genshin Impact.

She is a creation of Aino, serving as an all-utility maid and battle automaton created from various scraps from across the nations. Her core originated from Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk, the Eleventh of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords, as the part of her who wanted to abandon her vendetta against humanity and find a new place to belong.

After reaching Friendship Level 6 with Ineffa, a Krumkake Bolt may be obtained through the character menu.

Ineffa engages her Enhanced Cleaning Module, dealing a single instance of AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents, activating her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, and summoning the Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, BirgittaBirgittaIneffa's assistant and companion in battle, she can be summoned to the battlefield via Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
If there are opponents nearby, Birgitta will quickly move close to an opponent and unleash Discharge attacks every 2s, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
Only one Birgitta that has been summoned by Ineffa herself can exist at any one time.

Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means....
The Optical Flow Shield Barrier absorbs DMG based on Ineffa's ATK, and it will absorb Electro DMG with 250% effectiveness.

Panoramic Permutation Protocol
4th Ascension Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes

When using the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.

  • Ineffa's EM increase snapshots Ineffa's ATK at the moment of casting her Elemental Burst
Assemblage Hub
Moonsign Benediction Passive
When a party member triggers the Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Ineffa has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Ineffa is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
Flavor Synthesis Unit
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes

When Ineffa uses food, there is a 30% chance of gaining a seasoning ingredient.

Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means...

  • Ineffa must be in the active party for Flavor Synthesis Unit to take effect, but she does not need to be alive. The exception is for Recovery Dishes, which must be consumed by Ineffa to produce seasoning ingredients.
  • "Seasoning" ingredients that can be produced by this passive include:
    • Cream
    • Pepper
    • Salt
    • Spice
    • Sugar
  • The seasoning ingredients do not correspond to the food items consumed.
  • Seasoning ingredients can be produced from all items in the Food tab, including potions, items like Apples, and all Other Dishes.
  • Additionally, Birgitta's appearance can be altered by purchasing Ineffa's Toolbox from the Workshop's Trove.

Change History[]

Introduced in Version 5.7 • Released in Version 5.8
[Edit History]
Version "Luna I"
  • Adds Special Dish: Thunderclap Slash!
  • Updates to character voice-overs:
    • Updated the text for all languages:
      • "About Aino: Questions"
        • Old: ???
        • New: Aino once asked me an unusual question... Maybe it was because she noticed that I displayed intelligence beyond the level that she had predicted. In any case, the question was: "If one day, you realize that there's somewhere else you'd rather be, should I let you go, and be happy for you?" Detecting some emotion behind her words, I responded as follows: "If I were ever to leave you, our home would turn into a garbage dump within three months. So I would try to make sure I returned within that timeframe."
          Looking back... only now do I realize what she was truly feeling. She was reluctant for me to leave.

Version 5.8

  • Ineffa was released.

Version 5.7

  • June 23, 2025:
    • Ineffa was officially announced as a playable character in her Character Introduction: White Iron Forged the Body, Crimson Heart Cast the Soul.
  • July 18, 2025:
    • Ineffa appeared in the Version 5.8 "Sunspray Summer Resort" Trailer.

Version 5.5

  • Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk was mentioned in overworld text in Ancient Sacred Mountain.
